rows.ARS:
Pink blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: BARkel
rows.Bloom: Pink blend. Strong fragrance. Double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes:
According to Rose Barni, this rose was presented at Euroflora '91 in Geneva and that city's Lions Club asked for it to be named Helen Keller.
Author-lecturer Helen Keller was born on 27 June 1880 in Westport, Connecticut. She died on 1 June 1968.
